name: OmaStats
author: Carmine Paolino
description: System monitor for the Omarchy bar: CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, temperature, fan and battery stats with live graphs and a detailed panel. An iStat Menus-style activity monitor showing the machine's vital signs, configurable from inside the panel.

barWidget.description: System monitor readouts with live mini graphs: CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, temperature, fans and battery, each opening an iStat Menus-style panel with history graphs, ring gauges, sensors and top processes.

schema.label: Bar modules
schema.description: Comma-separated, in order: cpu, gpu, memory, disks, network, sensors, battery. Battery and GPU only appear when present; gpu expands to one readout per GPU picked in barGpus.

schema.label: Panel tabs
schema.description: Comma-separated tabs shown in the panel: cpu, gpu, memory, disks, network, sensors, battery.

schema.label: Bar style
schema.description: Default look of each bar readout: graph, ring, figure (text), graph and figure (both), or ring and figure. The Settings page can override it per module.

schema.label: Bar labels
schema.description: Stacked letters (CPU, MEM, NET) like iStat Menus, or glyphs.

schema.label: Disk readouts
schema.description: One bar readout per entry, as disk:show where disk is "all" or a block device like nvme0n1 and show is speed, used, or both; "none" hides them. Empty follows disksSource (pick them on the Settings page).

schema.label: Disk activity source
schema.description: Which disk the Disks page activity follows: "all" or a block device such as nvme0n1. Also the bar readout while barDisks is empty.

schema.label: Sensor readouts
schema.description: Comma-separated: cpu, gpu, or hwmon ids like nct6687/fan1 (pick them on the Settings page).

schema.label: GPU readouts
schema.description: Which GPUs get a bar readout: "all", "none", or comma-separated PCI addresses like 0000:01:00.0 (pick them on the Settings page).

schema.label: Show VRAM in horizontal bar
schema.description: Show a VRAM graph and percentage beside each selected GPU on horizontal bars when memory usage is reported.

schema.label: Bar graph width
schema.description: Width of each mini graph in the bar, in pixels.

schema.label: History (seconds)
schema.description: How far back the graphs reach.

schema.label: Look up public IP
schema.description: Ask api.ipify.org for your public address while the Network page is open.

schema.label: Utilization colors
schema.description: Color bar utilization and the GPU tab's load and VRAM histories by grade.

schema.label: Low utilization color
schema.description: Six-digit hex color for displayed 0–24% utilization; blank follows the current theme.

schema.label: Normal utilization color
schema.description: Six-digit hex color for displayed 25–59% utilization; blank follows the current theme.

schema.label: Warning utilization color
schema.description: Six-digit hex color for displayed 60–84% utilization; blank follows the current theme.

schema.label: Critical utilization color
schema.description: Six-digit hex color for displayed 85–100% utilization; blank follows the current theme.

schema.label: Top processes
schema.description: List the busiest processes on every page.
